Relax with the whole family at this peaceful residence. Close to the beach and outdoor area. Large garden with trampoline, play equipment, fire pan, hot tub and outdoor furniture. We have 4 bedrooms: 1 room with 120 cm bed, 1 room with 90 cm bed + drawer with mattress, 1 room with 150 cm bed + 90 cm bed and 1 room with 180 cm bed. TV in 3 of the rooms + living room.
